description.narrative: This Activity supports our Pacific partners to address the complex challenge of climate mobility (for situations where climate change and environmental factors are a driver for people moving, and for situations where people decide to stay in place). It comprises support to a range of partners (local and international NGOs, Pacific governments, regional organisations, researchers, UN agencies) to strengthen action at community, national, and regional levels.
